ov.noPoliciesBody: Once you have a policy you will see it here together with its payments and documents.
ov.allDoneBody: You have nothing outstanding. We will tell you when something is needed.
ov.renewalMeta: Expires {date} · {count, plural, =0 {expires today} one {1 day left} other {# days left}}
ov.unreadTitle: {count, plural, one {You have 1 new notification} other {You have # new notifications}}

pol.title: Your policies
pol.lead: See what each policy covers and until when it runs, and ask for changes without a phone call.
pol.emptyBody: When there is a policy in your name or your household's, it will appear here.
pol.notFoundBody: Check the address or go back to the list of your policies.

chg.title: Change your cover
chg.lead: Choose the cover you want and see what the change costs first. Nothing happens until you confirm.
chg.noCoverages: There is no cover that can be changed from here.
chg.previewFailed: The change could not be priced
chg.acknowledge: I have seen the cost and I want the change made.
chg.acknowledgeFirst: Confirm first that you have seen the cost.
chg.needsTeamBody: You can send it to our team, who will contact you.
chg.confirmedBody: The new cover applies from the date you saw. The new document will be in your documents.
chg.referred: The request was sent to our team
chg.referredBody: We will review it and contact you. Until then the policy stays as it is.

ren.title: Renew your policy
ren.lead: Accept our offer, or tell us you do not want to renew.
ren.noOffer: Our offer is not ready yet
ren.noOfferBody: No renewal offer has been issued for this policy yet. We will tell you when it is ready.
ren.acceptBody: The renewal starts when the current period ends. Payment will be requested separately.
ren.acknowledge: I have read the renewal offer and I want to renew.
ren.acknowledgeFirst: Confirm first that you have read the offer.
ren.declineTitle: I do not want to renew
ren.declineBody: Tell us why, so we can improve. The policy will simply expire.

done.DECLINED: We recorded that you are not renewing
done.REFERRED: The request was sent to our team

doneBody.DECLINED: The policy will expire at the end of the current period.
doneBody.REFERRED: We will review it and contact you.

can.title: Request cancellation
can.lead: Ask for a policy to be cancelled. Our team will confirm the date and any premium refund.
can.sentBody: Policy {number} is not cancelled yet. Our team will contact you to confirm the date.

pay.title: Your payments
pay.lead: See what you owe, which invoices were issued and the refunds you are expecting.
pay.noInvoicesBody: You have no invoices to pay.
pay.payFailed: The payment request did not complete
pay.soonBody: You have not been charged. Until online payment opens, use the payment method we gave you or write to us.
pay.referred: The request was sent to our team
pay.referredBody: You have not been charged. Our team will contact you about the payment.
pay.deniedBody: You have not been charged. Write to us from Messages and we will help.

docs.title: Your documents
docs.lead: Policies, receipts and anything else we sent you, to download whenever you need.
docs.emptyBody: The documents of your policies will appear here as soon as they are issued.
docs.downloadFailed: The download did not complete. Try again.

msg.title: Get in touch
msg.lead: Write to us and read our replies here. No phone call needed.
msg.emptyBody: When you write to us, or we write to you, the conversation will appear here.

ntf.title: Your notifications
ntf.lead: What needs your attention, and which notifications you want to receive.
ntf.emptyBody: We will notify you here when there is something new.
ntf.inbox: {count, plural, =0 {All read} one {1 new notification} other {# new notifications}}

prf.title: Your contact details
prf.lead: The address and phone numbers we hold for you. If something changed, correct it here.
prf.emptyBody: Add a phone number or an address so that we can reach you.
prf.noPoints: No phone number or e-mail is recorded.
prf.removeBody: It will be removed from your details. If it is the only one, we will not be able to reach you this way.
prf.stale: Your details changed in the meantime
prf.staleBody: We reloaded the current details. Check them and try the change again.
prf.referred: The request was sent to our team
prf.referredBody: Our team will check the change and it takes effect once approved.
